behaviour: Render a synchronized live preview mirror for styled text ranges, expose the active textarea selection across toolbar interactions, and shift range offsets on edits, paste, and indent/outdent.
rules: 1. Import shiftTextRanges, shiftTextRangesAtOffset, and splitTextIntoStyledSegments from @excalidraw/element.

2. Extend onChange to (nextOriginalText: string, nextTextStyles?: ExcalidrawTextElement["textStyles"]) => void and onSubmit to (data: { viaKeyboard: boolean; nextOriginalText: string; nextTextStyles?: ExcalidrawTextElement["textStyles"] }) => void.
3. Create a mirror preview div (className "excalidraw-wysiwyg-preview", dataset.type = "wysiwyg-preview", dir = "auto") appended to editorBox before editable and removed in cleanup().

4. In updateWysiwygStyle(), sync preview.style layout/typography/transform properties with editable.style; when updatedTextElement.textStyles?.length is non-empty, set editable.style.webkitTextFillColor = "transparent" and editable.style.caretColor = applyDarkModeFilter(updatedTextElement.strokeColor, appState.theme === THEME.DARK) while keeping editable.style.color set to the dark-mode-filtered strokeColor, and populate preview with <span> children for each segment from splitTextIntoStyledSegments(editable.value, updatedTextElement.textStyles) styled with dark-mode-filtered color and backgroundColor (and trailing newline preservation); when updatedTextElement.textStyles is empty or undefined, clear preview children and set editable.style.webkitTextFillColor = "".

5. Track prevOriginalText initialized to normalizeText(element.originalText) and pendingShiftedTextStyles; in indent() and outdent(), shift latest element textStyles at each modified line start index using shiftTextRangesAtOffset and store in pendingShiftedTextStyles; in editable.oninput, compute nextTextStyles from pendingShiftedTextStyles or shiftTextRanges(latestElement?.textStyles, prevOriginalText, editable.value), update prevOriginalText = editable.value, pass (editable.value, nextTextStyles) to onChange, and call updateWysiwygStyle().

6. Track savedSelectionOnMenuPress when temporarilyDisableSubmit() runs on properties/shape-actions pointerdown; wrap editable.setSelectionRange and input/keydown/pointerdown on editable to clear savedSelectionOnMenuPress when selection changes directly; register app.text.textWysiwygSelectionGetter to return the current [start, end] selection (using savedSelectionOnMenuPress if editable lost focus to the properties UI and selection collapsed) and clear it in cleanup(); in app.scene.onUpdate, sync prevOriginalText and restore savedSelectionOnMenuPress on editable if non-empty.

behaviour: Update actionChangeStrokeColor to style selected text substrings without mutating element.strokeColor or sticky-note ink, and register actionChangeTextHighlight owning the "textHighlight" openPopup id.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_ELEMENT_BACKGROUND_PICKS from @excalidraw/common and applyTextRangeStyle, getUniformTextRangeStyle from @excalidraw/element.

2. In actionChangeStrokeColor.perform(elements, appState, value, app), check if appState.editingTextElement is active and app?.text?.getTextWysiwygSelection() returns a selection with start < end; when true, update only the edited text element using applyTextRangeStyle(el.textStyles, el.originalText.length, selection, { color }, el.strokeColor), do not call syncStickyNoteInk, do not update el.strokeColor or currentItemStrokeColor, update editingTextElement in returned appState to the mutated element, and return CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY; when false (no active text editor or collapsed caret start === end), execute the existing element/sticky-note strokeColor logic unchanged.

3. In actionChangeStrokeColor.PanelComponent, when appState.editingTextElement is active and selection has start < end, pass getUniformTextRangeStyle(editingEl.textStyles, selection.start, selection.end, "color") ?? editingEl.strokeColor as the ColorPicker color prop; also map appState.openPopup === "textHighlight" to "canvasBackground" on the appState prop passed to ColorPicker in both actionChangeStrokeColor.PanelComponent and actionChangeBackgroundColor.PanelComponent so top-pick popup switching recognizes an open highlight popup while keeping openPopup !== type.

4. Register and export actionChangeTextHighlight (name: "changeTextHighlight", label: "labels.highlight") whose perform maps appStateUpdates.openPopup === "elementBackground" (sent by ColorPicker's updateData({ openPopup: type })) to "textHighlight" in the returned appState, applies applyTextRangeStyle(el.textStyles, el.originalText.length, selection, { highlight: color }) when appState.editingTextElement is active and selection has start < end (with "transparent" clearing highlight and CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY), and performs a safe no-op on elements when caret is collapsed.

5. In actionChangeTextHighlight.PanelComponent, render ColorPicker with DEFAULT_ELEMENT_BACKGROUND_PICKS, DEFAULT_ELEMENT_BACKGROUND_COLOR_PALETTE, type="elementBackground", label={t("labels.highlight")}, and an appState prop that maps appState.openPopup === "textHighlight" to "elementBackground" and maps appState.openPopup === "elementBackground" to "canvasBackground" (so ColorPicker opens if and only if the real appState.openPopup is "textHighlight", and never opens when actionChangeBackgroundColor sets appState.openPopup to "elementBackground").

behaviour: Render per-range SVG <rect> highlights and <tspan> coloured text runs in staticSvgScene.ts when textStyles is non-empty.
rules: 1. Import getFontString from @excalidraw/common and projectTextRangesOntoLines from @excalidraw/element.
2. In elementToSvg case "text", when !element.textStyles?.length, keep the existing per-line <text> loop unchanged so unstyled SVG output is byte-identical.

3. When element.textStyles?.length is non-empty, call projectTextRangesOntoLines(element.originalText, element.textStyles, { font: getFontString(element), wrappedText: element.text, elementWidth: element.width, textAlign: element.textAlign, baseDirection: direction }).

4. For each visual line i, first append <rect> elements in SVG_NS for each run with run.highlight && run.width > 0 (attributes x, y = i * lineHeightPx, width = run.width, height = lineHeightPx, fill = applyDarkModeFilter(run.highlight, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK)) before the line's <text> node; then create the line's <text> node with the same attributes as unstyled text and append <tspan> children for each run in logical order (setting fill = applyDarkModeFilter(run.color, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK) when run.color is defined).
